deepDiveText: RESET DONE, RE-RATING AHEAD 4th November 2026 Arihant Capital Markets Ltd Arihant Capital Markets Limited|Research Analyst SEBI Registration No: INH000002764 1011, Solitaire Corporate Park, Bldg No.10, 1st Floor, Andheri Ghatkopar Link Rd, Chakala, Andheri (E), Mumbai 400093 Sammaan Capital Ltd Initiating Coverage 4th Nov 2026 Sammaan Capital Ltd (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance) is a mortgage-led NBFC in the RBI's upper layer that is turning multi-product, now controlled by Abu Dhabi's IHC through Avenir. IHC has committed INR 88,500 Mn (about US$1bn) at INR 139 per share. The FY26 clean-up exited a INR 149,530 Mn non- core pool and took GNPA and NNPA to nil, leaving an opening AUM of INR 531,600 Mn. Provisional Q2FY27 data show disbursals of about INR 60,000 Mn (+55% QoQ) and AUM above INR 590,000 Mn. Investment Rationale 1. A sovereign-scale promoter changes the cost and availability of capital: IHC (ADX-listed; market cap about US$228bn, net worth about US$73bn) has made its first promoter-level investment in India: INR 56,527.5 Mn arrived on 31st March 2026 and tranche I (INR 9,059 Mn) was converted on 30th October 2026 (stake 33.32%) and INR 22,910 Mn is due by September 2027. CARE factors in IHC's commitment of support, including in unforeseen stress. Management puts the funding benefit at about INR 4,500 Mn a year pre-tax already, rising to about INR 10,000 Mn by FY27-end, and IHC adds procurement, technology and inorganic optionality. 2. The liability franchise is re-rating, and cost of funds is the biggest earnings lever: CRISIL, CARE and ICRA moved Sammaan to AA+ within about six weeks, Brickwork rates it AAA and Moody's has a positive outlook. Stock cost of funds fell from 10.9% (Q2FY26) to 10.0% (Q1FY27), with about 9.6% guided for September 2026, as lenders repriced bank loans. Our Base follows management's guided path to 7.8% by FY30E (consistent with AAA by FY29); every 25bp is worth INR 1,176 Mn to INR 1,721 Mn of PAT, and a stall at AA+ would cost INR 3,180 Mn of FY30E PAT. 3. A clean balance sheet, and recoveries that can surprise: The clean-up booked a INR 64,992 Mn exceptional loss and a INR 18,500 Mn overlay, leaving nil GNPA and NNPA, 99.6% collection efficiency and 97% of AUM secured. Q1FY27 alone delivered INR 9,150 Mn of recoveries and FV gains, an annualised INR 36,600 Mn against our Base FY27E of INR 32,000 Mn. ARC sales recovered 99% (FY23) and 95% (FY24); each extra INR 10,000 Mn recovered adds about INR 6.0 to book per share. 4. An origination platform, with new products turning a mortgage lender multi- product: Sammaan has sold down about INR 1,016 Bn across 24 partners, and DA and co-origination earn 17.5% to 26.4% RoE. Disbursals rose from INR 38,750 Mn in Q1FY27 to about INR 60,000 Mn in Q2FY27, with non-housing already 83% of Q1FY27 disbursals. Digital personal loans, micro-LAP and rural home loans launch in H2FY27, and gold, 2W/3W and BNPL in FY28; Base AUM reaches INR 1,781.2 Bn by FY30E (management about INR 1,940 Bn). 5. Operating leverage, after a near-term opex J curve: Headcount rises from 6,000 to 18,500 and branches from 217 to 1,605 by FY30, so opex leads revenue: Base opex goes from INR 15,730 Mn in FY27E to INR 29,276 Mn in FY30E. As productivity rises from 0.6 to 2+ loans per employee a month and 53 AI use cases go live, Base cost to income falls from 68% to 30% (management 26%), while core RoE ex-legacy (legacy carry added back, equity ex-DTA) climbs from 1.1% to 15.9%. 6. Ample capital and a governance upgrade: CRAR was 20.1% in Q1FY27 (about 29% pro-forma for warrants) and gearing 2.88x against a 3.5x to 4.0x guardrail, so with IHC's warrants (Tranche I converted on 30th October 2026, promoter now 33.32%) growth needs no new equity through FY29E. IHC nominees Alwyn Crasta and H.E. Dalia Khorshid (subject to shareholder approval) are on the board, a Big- 5 statutory auditor arrives from September 2027, quarterly business updates have begun, and the executive team led by MD and CEO Gagan Banga stays in place. We value the company at 2.0x FY29E adjusted book ex-DTA (ABVPS INR 179.0): FY29E is the first year in which the post-legacy, post-build-out franchise is visible in book, and excluding the DTA avoids paying a multiple on a tax asset. INR 360 is a 24 to 30 month plan-delivery value; its 12-month discounted equivalent is INR 296. At CMP the stock trades at 0.84x FY26A and 0.67x FY29E adjusted book, 14% below IHC's INR 139 entry price and 38% below its 52-week high of INR 192. Listed anchors trade at 1.4x (Five Star) to 4.0x (Poonawalla) book, and conglomerate-backed diversified NBFCs at 2x to 4x. The 2.0x multiple is a delivery-of-plan multiple: it needs a sustainable RoE of about 19% against our Base FY29E RoE of 11.9% (core ex-legacy 11.4%; Bull 17.3%, management 16.9%). Our ROE bridge takes Base FY30E RoE of 16.0% to 20.3% as the legacy pool is fully monetised, AAA arrives in full, cost to income falls to management's 26% and mix lifts yields further. Fundamental cross-checks sit below the target: segment SOTP INR 151 to INR 203, FY28E scenario-weighted P/ABV INR 145 and Bear FY28E at 0.60x INR 80.
